'''''Darksaber''''' is a [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] novel written by [[Kevin J. Anderson]] and published by [[Bantam Spectra]] in [[October]] [[1995]]. It is the second volume of an informal trilogy involving ex–[[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Callista Ming]], following [[Children of the Jedi (novel)|''Children of the Jedi'']] ([[1995]]) and preceding ''[[Planet of Twilight]]'' ([[1997]]), both written by [[Barbara Hambly]].

An [[Darksaber (abridged audiobook)|audio version]] narrated by [[Anthony Heald]] was released in 2007.
